speaker: john_heminges
text: Is that the canvas? Give it here before we call the act. My man will take it to the Bell. You are not walking that far.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threescore shillings in the canvas, and the line under the twine. He has both. I am not going to Carter Lane.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, sixty shillings. Item, one letter. He does not need you on the road to carry either.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A parcel, before we have said good morning. Some of us came here to rehearse a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then rehearse the door. The parcel is John's, and the morning is still the morning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: My man goes. He will not make you a speech about it. Entrances, as yesterday. We are on at two.

speaker: will_kemp
text: On at two, and no riddles in the tiring-house. I accept the parcel if it gets out of my way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is out of your way. God give you the rehearsal.
